visualCharacteristics.purpose: one web form (feedback, subscription): text fields, comment textarea, checkboxes and a Submit button

contentPattern.structure: one row per field: Label (trailing * = required) | type (text, email, tel, number, date, textarea, checkbox, checkboxes, radio, select, hidden, submit) | options or placeholder; settings rows: action | submit URL, method | POST/GET, thank you | message; single-cell rows are intro text

reuseGuidance: One form block per web form; its fields and Submit button are parts of it, never separate blocks.
